Summary: Merlin had been gone all week. Normally, that wouldn’t make Arthur worried. Merlin was a person who very much liked to deal with things himself, even if Arthur wished his husband would keep him in the loop more. He was supposed to have left for a simple flight patrol but hadn’t been back since. Arthur wasn’t worried because he was afraid for him, no. Merlin had been trekking through a forest for a week. A whole week! He was proud of himself, he didn’t know he was in this good shape. He would have to brag to Arthur about it when he got back- Arthur. Arthur back in Camelot…. That was something he had overlooked.   It was fine! If this was as important as he thought it was, Arthur would understand.  It wasn’t like this was the first time he had done this- or the worst. The worst was when he had been gone for a full month without contact to… well, never mind what he was doing, the point was it’s really jarring to come back to your lover wearing fully black and a whole kingdom mourning your death. Arthur wouldn’t throw him another funeral again. Probably. (Or, Merlin finds an egg in the strangest of places.)
